body: From the DM-172 review (orchestrator, this run): pin in tests the timing fixtures in src/core/space/fixtures/timing/ and scratch/DM-172 scenarios, plus: fractional-ms `active_ms` gives a valid ISO timestamp; host+agent spans on one attempt that do not overlap (host 10:00-10:10, agent 10:20-11:00); inclusive worker with an unscoped sub-agent (timingActivity.ts:203-209 leaves a hole: active 60m of 80m); performance stays linear at 20k spans.
